rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP Protocol Conformance is a test harness MCP server that validates Model Context Protocol server implementations against JSON-RPC 2.0 wire compliance, OAuth 2.1 PKCE flows, tool schemas, and capability advertisement across MCP spec versions 2024-11-05, 2025-03-26, and 2025-06-18. It exposes 12 MCP tools and is also installable as a dev library via npm package mcp-protocol-conformance.
